basic_info.description: Exceptional Corner House! Nestled on a private cul-de-sac in the heart of the Excelsior, this semi-attached 3 bedroom 1 bath house sits proudly on a corner lot, offering both comfort and convenience. Owned and cherished by the same family since it was built in 1957, the home carries a legacy of warmth and care that is ready for its next chapter.  Step into the bright living room with a cozy fireplace and enjoy the charm of refinished hardwood floors throughout. The updated kitchen is perfect for home chefs, while the freshly painted interior provides a move-in ready feel. Generous bedroom sizes ensure space for everyone.  Outside, enjoy a low maintenance backyard and a huge garage with endless possibilities for storage, hobbies, or expansion. Located directly across from McLaren Park, San Francisco's second largest park, you will find hiking trails, scenic Southern Hills views, and even an amphitheater just steps from your door.  Commuters will love the easy access to Hwy 280 & 101, while the shops, cafes, and restaurants of San Bruno Ave are only minutes away. You do not want to miss this amazing large home offering incredible space, comfort, and value in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods.
